summary: Lebanon experienced 67 alerts including 9 drone sightings, 5 airstrikes, and 21 artillery strikes across southern sectors on November 5, per Red Alert Lebanon data. Iran conducted a missile test launch from Qorveh, Kurdistan Province, while IRGC Ground Forces commander Mohammad Karami visited Strait of Hormuz islands. Iraq imposed temporary airspace restrictions over Baghdad, Erbil, Sulaimaniyah, and Kirkuk for military operations November 7–11.

sections.executive_summary: Lebanon's southern border absorbed 21 artillery strikes and 5 airstrikes on November 5, with an Israeli suicide-capable drone identified over Beirut. Iran simultaneously tested a missile from Kurdistan Province and deployed its IRGC Ground Forces commander to Strait of Hormuz islands, while the U.S. DIA disclosed Iranian offensive space operations. Iraq closed airspace over four major cities for military operations November 7–11, and Saudi Arabia signed a defense pact with Syria.

points: Iran conducted a missile test launch from Qorveh in Kurdistan Province at 14:25 local time (1055Z) on November 5, as reported by the FromIran monitoring system with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12034)
IRGC Ground Forces commander Mohammad Karami visited islands in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian media footage cited by Conflict Radar. (Source: @shin_persian/12036)
Four explosions occurred near Izeh in Khuzestan Province due to unexploded ordnance (UXO) disposal operations, per FromIran delayed post. (Source: @shin_persian/12032)
The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) issued Warning 196-26, indicating maritime security concerns in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12029)

A U.S. Defense Intelligence Agency report identified Iran as an emerging space power and stated Tehran conducted offensive operations against U.S. space capabilities during Operation Epic Fury. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9680)
Former U.S. President Trump remarked he prefers not to destroy what remains of Iran but may have to, adding Iran "does nothing without U.S. approval." (Source: @N12chat/233652)

President Herzog concluded consultations with Knesset factions; 67 MKs recommended Gadi Eisenkot (Yashar party) for prime minister, while 46 backed incumbent Netanyahu, with Herzog to assign mandate Sunday. (Source: @amitsegal/66877, @yediotnews25/137369)

Avigdor Lieberman reportedly dropped his veto on Haredi parties, enabling the "change bloc" to pursue a coalition with United Torah Judaism based on a lenient draft law. (Source: @yediotnews25/137374)

Shin Bet chief David Zini labeled foreign election funding "the largest strategic terrorist attack in state history," comparing it to the Simchat Torah massacre intelligence failure. (Source: @amitsegal/66866)

Herzog questioned the Joint List on whether they would withdraw support during a major security campaign involving Iran or Hamas; leader Yousef Jabareen responded they would make strategic decisions. (Source: @yediotnews25/137367)
Israeli warplanes were active over southern Lebanon, per Red Alert Lebanon live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/51874)
An Israeli Orbiter-family drone, including a suicide variant, was identified over Beirut by Red Alert Lebanon analysts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51896)

Herzog asked the Joint List whether they would cease support for an Eisenkot-led government if a significant security campaign erupted involving Hamas in Gaza; the party responded it would make strategic decisions based on its values. (Source: @yediotnews25/137367)

Red Alert Lebanon's daily report for November 5 recorded 67 total alerts, including 9 drone sightings (most in Mashghara, Qatrani, Kfar Dounin, Baalbek, Nabha), 5 airstrikes (Kfar Tibnit 3, Wadi al-Saluqi 1, Barishit 1), and 21 artillery shelling incidents across 10 locations led by Wadi Zibqin (5), Barishit (3), Khiam (3). (Source: @redlinkleb/51912)
Analysts identified a tailless drone over Beirut as an Israeli Orbiter-family UAV, noting one variant has a suicide configuration. (Source: @redlinkleb/51896)
French UNIFIL battalion at Brig Qalaouiyeh conducted exercises with loudspeakers and sirens between 20:30 and 22:00 local time. (Source: @redlinkleb/51873)
Live map showed active firefighting and artillery in Wadi al-Saluqi, Mays al-Jabal, Barishit, and Shqra sectors. (Source: @redlinkleb/51931)
An explosion was reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, per live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/51922)
Israeli warplanes were observed over southern Lebanon on live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/51874)
Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defense cooperation agreement during Syrian President al-Sharaa's visit to Riyadh, per Saudi Press Agency. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9671)

Iraq issued a NOTAM imposing temporary airspace restrictions from November 7–11, daily 0500–1100 UTC, due to active military operations, affecting Baghdad, Erbil, Sulaimaniyah, and Kirkuk airports. (Source: @shin_persian/12042)

Emirates Group reported first-half 2026 after-tax profit dropped 66% to $1.1 billion, attributing the decline to the Iran war disrupting air travel and raising fuel costs, with passenger traffic down 22%. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9669)
